Showtime · Assessment Menu

How Your Performance Shines

We look at how well you sing, play your chosen pattern, keep the beat and perform with your ensemble.

What we assessBeginning (1)Developing (2)Competent (3)Accomplished (4)
Singing AccuracySings along with support, beginning to follow the melody.Sings some phrases with accurate pitch and rhythm.Sings most phrases with accurate pitch and rhythm.Sings confidently with accurate pitch and rhythm throughout.
Instrumental AccuracyPlays parts of the chosen pattern with guidance.Plays some parts of the chosen pattern accurately.Plays most of the chosen pattern accurately.Plays the chosen pattern accurately and consistently throughout.
Rhythmic AccuracyBegins to follow the steady beat with support.Maintains a steady beat for some sections.Maintains a steady beat for most of the performance.Maintains a steady beat consistently throughout the performance.
Ensemble CoordinationParticipates in the ensemble with guidance and support.Joins in with the ensemble and stays together for some sections.Performs together with the ensemble for most of the song.Performs confidently and consistently in time with the ensemble throughout.

Assessment: Four criteria, scored 1–4 each. Total: 16 marks.

Your part, your progress. You can choose ukulele, xylophone or percussion and the playing level that suits you. You can achieve Accomplished (4) by performing your chosen pattern accurately and confidently, even when the pattern is simple.
